targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(timestamp) AS time, count(*) AS "requests" FROM activity_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(to_timestamp(timestamp)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT to_timestamp(timestamp) AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status_code >= 400)::float / count(*) * 100 AS "error_pct" FROM activity_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(to_timestamp(timestamp)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT to_timestamp(timestamp) AS time, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS "p50", percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS "p95" FROM activity_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(to_timestamp(timestamp)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT provider, count(*) AS "requests" FROM activity_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(to_timestamp(timestamp)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
SELECT action, count(*) AS "count" FROM activity_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(to_timestamp(timestamp)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15
SELECT date_trunc('day', to_timestamp(timestamp)) AS time, count(DISTINCT user_email) AS "active_users" FROM activity_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(to_timestamp(timestamp)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
